verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents its own per-request controls over what it retains. The `cf-aig-collect-log` header overrides the gateway's default logging, and `cf-aig-collect-log-payload` decides whether raw prompt and response bodies are stored, so usage metadata can be kept without persisting sensitive content. This covers the retention-control half of the story, but nothing in the pack shows log deletion or retention periods. Missing for 10: documented log deletion (manual or via API), configurable retention periods or auto-expiry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: The \`cf-aig-collect-log\` header allows you to bypass the default log setting for the gateway.
The `cf-aig-collect-log-payload` header allows you to control whether the raw request and response bodies (payloads) are stored for a given request.
This is useful when you want to maintain visibility into usage metrics and request metadata without persisting sensitive prompt or completion data.
